## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 30, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Morrigan Chichester_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "the censoring that no other similar app has is rediculous and makes the app entirely unusable, especially with no way to turn it off as the whole system is personally stuck on safe mode even if it's off. it used to be stellar and the bot works awesome otherwise but the censorship makes it entirely unusable as it also just happens randomly at times. 1/10 with censorship, 9/10 if they ever get rid of it."
            2. _KiritoNoiharaQuartz_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "They're doing it on purpose now. Every time I email them about an issue I'm having, they ask me for a screenshot of the issue or the CiD of the character. The PolyBuzz app doesn't support screenshots! And if your character has a violation, you can't view the CiD without editing the character and getting rid of the problem that caused you to email them in the first place. How are we supposed to report these problems to you if everything you need to "fix" it is stuff we can't access?"
